scope: Declarative validation of additive technical scope, realization and citation allocation records before any surface rendering.

rules.accept_when: required_case_ids is a subset of planned_case_ids and required_dependency is present

rules.applies_when: a claim has a v2 citation allocation
rules.accept_when: selected keys are owned, independently sufficient and semantically match the topic; excluded keys are absent

rules.applies_when: a required topic declares a maximum boundary
rules.accept_when: the boundary claim and its linked consequence are both allocated
semantic_subject equals criterion_fact_ids and no forbidden subject is selected
the linked consequence remains in the same claim group
rendered_units equals 0 and no draft artifact is produced

relationship_to_frozen_validator: These codes are pre-surface technical-contract failures. They add, rename and remove no Draft Validator failure code. The frozen Draft Validator v1.2 remains unchanged.
